preconditions.description: The number of servers is between 1 and 500,000, inclusive.
The number of pairs of servers directly connected by a data communication channel is between 0 and the maximum possible number of such pairs, inclusive.
The parameter k defines the range of possible values for encryption keys, which is between 0 and 60, inclusive.
Each server's encryption key is between 0 and 2^k - 1, inclusive.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= u_i, v_i <= n and u_i != v_i
preconditions.description: Each pair of servers directly connected by a data communication channel is represented by two distinct integers between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is a single integer, which is the number of safe infections of some subset of servers by a virus with some parameter, modulo 10^9 + 7.

invariants.expression: all(c_i_1 != c_i_2 for (u_i_1, v_i_1), (u_i_2, v_i_2) in combinations(edges, 2) if u_i_1 == u_i_2 and v_i_1 == v_i_2)
invariants.description: The initial assignment of encryption keys guarantees that all data communication channels remain safe.

invariants.expression: all(c_i_1 ⊕ c_i_2 != c_j_1 ⊕ c_j_2 for (u_i_1, v_i_1), (u_i_2, v_i_2) in combinations(edges, 2) for (u_j_1, v_j_1), (u_j_2, v_j_2) in combinations(edges, 2) if u_i_1 == u_j_1 and v_i_1 == v_j_1 and u_i_2 == u_j_2 and v_i_2 == v_j_2)
invariants.description: The condition that all data communication channels remain safe is preserved when any server's encryption key is changed by the bitwise XOR operation with some number x.
